pandas.Series.to_json

pandas 3.1.1 · Series and accessors · method

Serialize the object to JSON. Choose orient for the layout and lines for line-delimited records where supported.

Call syntax

Series.to_json(…) Full signature
Series.to_json(
    path_or_buf=None,
    *,
    orient=None,
    date_format=None,
    double_precision=10,
    force_ascii=True,
    date_unit='ms',
    default_handler=None,
    lines=False,
    compression='infer',
    index=None,
    indent=None,
    storage_options=None,
    mode='w',
)
